name: Mark Gamba

bio.statement: Gamba's official legislative biography says he is one of the few renters serving in the Oregon Legislature.
bio.excerpt: Mark is one of the few renters currently serving in the Oregon State Legislature.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Gamba member page

bio.statement: His official biography says climate change was the core reason he first ran for Milwaukie City Council.

bio.statement: Ballotpedia lists photographer as Gamba's profession and describes his career as including commercial photography, photojournalism and small business ownership.

positions.statement: In a 2020 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey for a congressional race, Gamba described climate change as the greatest threat humanity has faced.
positions.excerpt: Climate Change is the greatest threat humanity has ever faced.

positions.statement: In the same 2020 survey, Gamba said health care is a human right.
positions.excerpt: Health Care is a human right.
